title: Why does my account have a lower balance than I expected or have a negative balance?
summary: Explains causes of lower or negative balances in Rho-Bank accounts, including overdraft protections, authorization holds, pending card transactions/checks, and scheduled payments/transfers earmarking funds. Also covers resolution steps and debit-card decline codes: CODE 51 (Insufficient Funds), with a 1–3 business day hold-release note and common hold sources ($75–$150 gas; hotels/car rentals/tip buffer; pending status review), and CODE 52 (No Checking Account), including waiting 10–15 minutes for possible sync issues.
